stories.title: Sources: Simmons, Kings agree to one-year deal
stories.summary: Ben Simmons is back in the NBA after reaching one-year, $3.5 million deal with the Kings, his agents Max Wiepking, Sean Tribe and Ryan Arney told Andscape and ESPN's Shams Charania.

stories.title: La. judge clears pro athletes to return to LSU
stories.summary: Dae'Quan Wright and Zxavian Harris have been cleared to return to college football after brief stints in the NFL, according to a judge's orders, setting up a dramatic showdown between the SEC and LSU.

stories.title: Lombardi resigns as UNC GM amid investigation
stories.summary: Michael Lombardi has resigned as general manager of the North Carolina football team, which he had joined when Bill Belichick was hired in late 2024.
